title: コンピュータアーキテクチャ基礎
subtitle: Fundamental Computer Architecture
keywords: Von Neumann computer 2.Instruction set architecture 3.Pipeline processing 4.Memory architecture 5.Local Cooperation
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) Learn data processing using a computer. (2) Learn computer architecture that define assignments between hardware and software for data processing. (3) Learn the basic structure and operating principles of a computer.
advice: This is the basic course on computer architecture. We will cover the following materials: 1. Data flow and control flow 2. Instruction set architecture 3. Pipeline processing 4. Cache and virtual memory 5. Embedded processor Students are required to calculate binary numbers. Students are expected to understand the meaning of terms and characteristics. Students are expected to understand the actions of logical circuits using a logic circuit simulator. Students are expected to review the contents of each course.
books: Textbooks: Computer Architecture (in Japanese) Reference books: Introduction to Logic Circuits (in Japanese) Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of binary arithmetic and basic logic gates is required.

activityGoals.body: Be able to add and subtract values in a computer system using column addition.
Be able to show the internal structure of a CPU and explain the calculation process.
Be able to explain the structure of an instruction word in a computer system and addressing mode.
Be able to explain memory hierarchy with some examples.
Be able to explain the characteristic of embedded processor with some examples.
